verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a complete double-entry accounting system, so locking closed periods is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions period close, period locking, closing dates, or reopening controls. Role-tailored accountant permissions and bill approval rules are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
